summary: CareCloud, Inc. filed an amendment (Form 8-K/A) to an earlier 8-K disclosing a credit agreement with Citizens Bank and Provident Bank providing a $40M term loan and $10M revolver. The amendment adds exhibits for a Securities Account Pledge Agreement and a Warrant, both executed July 22, 2026, related to post-closing collateral conditions. Executive Chairman Mahmud Haq pledged 4,300,000 shares as collateral and received a warrant for the same number of shares at $5.00 per share. This is a routine financing amendment and not a special situation; no change of control or strategic event is involved. What to watch: none.
